# ESP WebFlash Toolkit — Complete API Reference

> Flash ESP32 firmware from a browser. No installs, no drivers, just a URL.

npm: esp-webflash-toolkit | License: MIT
GitHub: adam-weber/esp-webflash-toolkit

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install esp-webflash-toolkit
```

Browser (CDN):
```html
<!-- Core only -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/esp-webflash-toolkit@latest/dist/esp-webflash-toolkit.min.js"></script>

<!-- Core + vanilla adapter -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/esp-webflash-toolkit@latest/dist/esp-webflash-toolkit-full.min.js"></script>

<!-- Web component (self-registers <esp-flasher>) -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/esp-webflash-toolkit@latest/dist/esp-flasher-component.min.js"></script>
```

---

## Simple API: flashDevice()

Flash a device in one function call.

```javascript
import { flashDevice } from 'esp-webflash-toolkit';

const result = await flashDevice({
  firmware: 'https://example.com/firmware.bin',  // Required: firmware URL
  config: { wifi_ssid: 'MyNetwork', wifi_pass: 'secret' },  // Optional: NVS config
  chip: 'esp32s3',              // Optional: expected chip type
  onProgress: (percent) => {},  // Optional: progress callback (0-100)
  onLog: (msg, level) => {},    // Optional: log callback
  firmwareOffset: 0x10000,      // Optional (default: 0x10000)
  nvsOffset: 0x9000             // Optional (default: 0x9000)
});
// Returns: { chipType: string, macAddr: string }
```

---

## Advanced API: ESPFlasher

Event-driven class for full control over the flash process. Use this for custom UIs.

```javascript
import { ESPFlasher } from 'esp-webflash-toolkit';
```

### Constructor

```javascript
new ESPFlasher({
  chip?: string,              // Expected chip type (e.g., 'esp32s3')
  firmwareUrl?: string,       // Firmware download URL
  fields?: Array,             // Config field definitions or preset names
  firmwareOffset?: number,    // Default: 0x10000
  nvsOffset?: number,         // Default: 0x9000
  nvsSize?: number,           // Default: 0x6000
  nvsNamespace?: string,      // Default: 'config'
})
```

### Methods

connect(): Promise<{chipType: string, macAddr: string}>
  Connect to device via Web Serial. Prompts user to select port.

disconnect(): Promise<void>
  Close serial connection.

isConnected(): boolean
  Check connection status.

getDevice(): DeviceConnection
  Access low-level device connection.

flash(opts?): Promise<boolean>
  Flash firmware + NVS config. Options can override firmwareUrl, firmwareOffset, or pass customFirmware (File/Blob). Returns true on success.

flashConfig(): Promise<boolean>
  Flash only NVS config partition (no firmware). Returns true on success.

reset(): Promise<void>
  Hard reset the device.

dispose(): void
  Clean up resources and disconnect.

setConfig(values: Object): void
  Set NVS config values (e.g., { wifi_ssid: 'test' }).

getConfig(): Object
  Get current config values.

getSchema(): Field[]
  Get config field definitions.

setVariant(variant: Variant, resolvedUrl?: string): void
  Switch active firmware variant (v2 config).

### Events

All events use CustomEvent with data in `e.detail`.

| Event | Detail | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| progress | {percent, written?, total?} | Flash progress (0-100). written/total present during firmware write only |
| log | {message, level} | Log message. Levels: info, debug, warning, error, success |
| status | {state, message} | State change with human-readable message |
| connected | {chipType, macAddr} | Device connected successfully |
| disconnected | {} | Device disconnected |
| error | {error, message} | Error occurred |
| error-classified | {type, title, steps[], chipSpecific} | Error with recovery instructions |
| complete | {} | Flash completed successfully |
| chip-mismatch | {expected, detected, proceed(), cancel()} | Chip type doesn't match. Call proceed() or cancel(). |
| state-change | {from, to, label} | State machine transition |
| change | {key?, value?, values?} | Config value changed |
| schema-changed | {schema} | Config field schema updated |

### Example

```javascript
const flasher = new ESPFlasher({
  chip: 'esp32s3',
  firmwareUrl: 'https://github.com/user/repo/releases/latest/download/firmware.bin',
  fields: ['wifi', { key: 'device_name', label: 'Device Name', type: 'text' }]
});

flasher.addEventListener('progress', e => console.log(`${e.detail.percent}%`));
flasher.addEventListener('log', e => console.log(`[${e.detail.level}] ${e.detail.message}`));
flasher.addEventListener('connected', e => console.log(`Connected: ${e.detail.chipType}`));
flasher.addEventListener('error-classified', e => {
  console.log(`Error: ${e.detail.title}`);
  e.detail.steps.forEach(s => console.log(`  - ${s}`));
});

await flasher.connect();
flasher.setConfig({ wifi_ssid: 'MyNetwork', wifi_pass: 'secret', device_name: 'sensor-01' });
await flasher.flash();
await flasher.reset();
flasher.dispose();
```

---

## NVSGenerator

Generate ESP-IDF compatible NVS partition binaries.

```javascript
import { NVSGenerator } from 'esp-webflash-toolkit/nvs-generator';

const nvs = new NVSGenerator();

// Generate binary from namespace/key/value structure
const binary = nvs.generate({
  config: {                    // "config" is the NVS namespace
    wifi_ssid: 'MyNetwork',   // String values
    wifi_pass: 'secret',
    device_name: 'sensor-01',
    retry_count: 5             // Numeric values (auto-selects U8/U16/U32)
  }
}, 0x6000);  // Optional: partition size in bytes (default: 0x6000 = 24KB)

// Returns: Uint8Array (flash this to NVS partition at 0x9000)

// Parse an existing NVS binary back to key-value pairs
const parsed = nvs.parse(binary);
```

### Reading NVS in Firmware

```c
// C/C++ (ESP-IDF)
nvs_handle_t handle;
nvs_open("config", NVS_READONLY, &handle);
char ssid[32];
size_t len = sizeof(ssid);
nvs_get_str(handle, "wifi_ssid", ssid, &len);
```

```rust
// Rust (esp-idf-svc)
let nvs = EspNvs::new(partition, "config", true)?;
let ssid = nvs.get_str("wifi_ssid")?;
```

---

## ConfigStore

Pure state container for device configuration.

```javascript
import { ConfigStore, FieldPresets, expandFieldPresets } from 'esp-webflash-toolkit';

const store = new ConfigStore();
store.setSchema(expandFieldPresets(['wifi', { key: 'name', label: 'Name', type: 'text' }]));
store.set('wifi_ssid', 'MyNetwork');
store.setAll({ wifi_pass: 'secret', name: 'sensor' });
const all = store.getAll();       // { wifi_ssid: 'MyNetwork', wifi_pass: 'secret', name: 'sensor' }
const nvsData = store.toNVS();    // Same, but only non-empty string values
const { valid, missing } = store.validate();  // Check required fields
```

### Field Presets

| Preset | Expands to |
|--------|-----------|
| "wifi" | wifi_ssid (text, required), wifi_pass (password, required) |
| "mqtt" | mqtt_host (text), mqtt_user (text), mqtt_pass (password) |
| "device_name" | device_name (text) |

### Field Definition

```javascript
{
  key: string,          // NVS key name
  label: string,        // Display label
  type?: string,        // 'text' (default), 'password', 'email', 'number', etc.
  placeholder?: string,
  required?: boolean,   // Default: false
  default?: string,     // Default value
  pattern?: string,     // Regex validation pattern
  help?: string,        // Help text
  section?: string      // Grouping key
}
```

---

## Flash States

```javascript
import { FlashStates, FlashStateMachine } from 'esp-webflash-toolkit';

// States: IDLE, READY, CONNECTING, CONNECTED, DOWNLOADING, GENERATING, WRITING, VERIFYING, COMPLETE, ERROR

const sm = new FlashStateMachine(); // Starts at IDLE
sm.addEventListener('state-change', e => {
  console.log(`${e.detail.from} → ${e.detail.to}: ${e.detail.label}`);
});
sm.transition(FlashStates.CONNECTING); // Returns true if valid
sm.state;  // 'connecting'
sm.label;  // 'Connecting...'
sm.reset(); // Back to IDLE
```

---

## Error Classification

```javascript
import { classifyError, isBrowserSupported, isMobile } from 'esp-webflash-toolkit';

// Classify an error with recovery steps
const classified = classifyError(error, { chip: 'esp32s3' });
// Returns: { type, title, steps[], chipSpecific }

// Error types: connection_timeout, port_in_use, download_failed, write_failed,
//              disconnected_during_flash, chip_mismatch, no_port_selected, unknown

// Browser support check
const { supported, reason } = isBrowserSupported();
const mobile = isMobile();
```

---

## Config Schema v2

```javascript
import { normalizeConfig, resolveVariantFirmwareUrl, validateConfig, chipIdToName } from 'esp-webflash-toolkit';

// Normalize v1 or v2 config to v2 format
const config = normalizeConfig(rawJson);

// Resolve firmware URL for a variant
const url = resolveVariantFirmwareUrl(config.variants[0], config);

// Validate
const { valid, errors } = validateConfig(config);

// Chip ID from binary header
chipIdToName(0x0009); // 'esp32s3'
```

---

## <esp-flasher> Web Component

Self-contained custom element with Shadow DOM. Drop-in flash button for any page.

### Usage

```html
<!-- Load component (self-registers) -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/esp-webflash-toolkit@latest/dist/esp-flasher-component.min.js"></script>

<!-- From inline attributes (compact button, opens modal on click) -->
<esp-flasher firmware="https://..." chip="esp32" fields="wifi"></esp-flasher>

<!-- From config URL -->
<esp-flasher config="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/user/repo/main/flash-config.json"></esp-flasher>

<!-- From GitHub repo (auto-discovers config or releases) -->
<esp-flasher repo="user/repo"></esp-flasher>

<!-- Full inline mode (no modal) -->
<esp-flasher config="..." mode="full"></esp-flasher>

<!-- Dark theme -->
<esp-flasher config="..." theme="dark"></esp-flasher>

<!-- Auto theme (follows OS preference) -->
<esp-flasher config="..." theme="auto"></esp-flasher>

<!-- Inline JSON config -->
<esp-flasher config-data='{"version":2,"name":"My Project","variants":[...]}'></esp-flasher>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| config | URL | Load flash-config.json from URL |
| config-data | JSON string | Inline config JSON |
| firmware | URL | Firmware download URL |
| chip | esp32, esp32s3, etc. | Expected chip type |
| fields | comma-separated | Field presets: "wifi", "mqtt", "device_name" |
| repo | "user/repo" | GitHub repo (auto-discovers config) |
| mode | "compact" (default), "full" | compact = button+modal, full = inline card |
| theme | "light" (default), "dark", "auto" | Color scheme |
| preview | (boolean) | Skip browser/mobile checks |

### Events (composed, bubbles through Shadow DOM)

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| esp-flasher:connected | {chipType, macAddr} |
| esp-flasher:complete | {} |
| esp-flasher:error | {error, message} |

### Programmatic Access

```javascript
const el = document.querySelector('esp-flasher');
el.flasher;  // Internal ESPFlasher instance

el.addEventListener('esp-flasher:complete', () => {
  console.log('Flash done!');
});
```

---

## flash-config.json

Configuration file for hosted flash pages. Place in repo root.

### v1 (Simple)

```json
{
  "name": "My Project",
  "firmware": "firmware.bin",
  "chip": "esp32s3",
  "offset": "0x10000",
  "fields": ["wifi", { "key": "device_name", "label": "Device Name" }]
}
```

### v2 (Multi-variant)

```json
{
  "version": 2,
  "name": "My Project",
  "repo": "user/repo",
  "release": "latest",
  "branding": {
    "logo": "https://example.com/logo.png",
    "primaryColor": "#6366f1",
    "theme": "light"
  },
  "variants": [
    {
      "id": "standard",
      "name": "Standard Edition",
      "description": "Full firmware with all features",
      "firmware": "firmware.bin",
      "chip": "esp32s3",
      "offset": "0x10000",
      "nvsOffset": "0x9000",
      "fields": ["wifi", "mqtt", { "key": "device_name", "label": "Device Name" }]
    },
    {
      "id": "lite",
      "name": "Lite Edition",
      "description": "Minimal firmware",
      "firmware": "firmware-lite.bin",
      "chip": "esp32c3",
      "fields": ["wifi"]
    }
  ],
  "postFlash": {
    "title": "Setup Complete!",
    "steps": ["Power cycle the device", "Connect to WiFi", "Open http://device.local"],
    "link": { "label": "Getting Started", "url": "https://docs.example.com" }
  }
}
```

### Field Reference

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| version | 2 | yes (v2) | Config version |
| name | string | yes | Project name |
| repo | "user/repo" | no | GitHub repo for firmware URL resolution |
| release | string | no | Release tag or "latest" (default) |
| branding.logo | URL | no | Logo image |
| branding.primaryColor | "#rrggbb" | no | Accent color |
| branding.theme | "light"/"dark" | no | Default theme |
| variants | array | yes (v2) | Firmware variants |
| variants[].id | string | no | Unique identifier |
| variants[].name | string | no | Display name |
| variants[].description | string | no | Description text |
| variants[].firmware | string | yes | Filename (resolved against repo releases) or absolute URL |
| variants[].chip | string | no | esp32, esp32s2, esp32s3, esp32c3, esp32c2, esp32c6, esp32h2, esp8266 |
| variants[].offset | hex/number | no | Firmware flash offset (default: 0x10000) |
| variants[].nvsOffset | hex/number | no | NVS partition offset (default: 0x9000) |
| variants[].fields | array | no | Config fields or preset names |
| postFlash.title | string | no | Completion screen title |
| postFlash.steps | string[] | no | Post-flash instructions |
| postFlash.link | {label, url} | no | Link shown after flashing |

---

## Vanilla JS Adapter

Pre-wired UI helpers for vanilla JavaScript projects.

```javascript
import { createFlasher } from 'esp-webflash-toolkit/adapters/vanilla';

const { flasher, ui, dispose } = createFlasher({
  chip: 'esp32s3',
  firmwareUrl: 'https://example.com/firmware.bin',
  fields: ['wifi'],
  elements: {
    statusBox: document.getElementById('status'),
    progressFill: document.getElementById('progress'),
    logContainer: document.getElementById('log'),
    connectBtn: document.getElementById('connect'),
    flashBtn: document.getElementById('flash')
  },
  storageKey: 'my-flasher'  // Optional: persist config to localStorage
});
```

---

## CLI

```bash
npx esp-webflash-toolkit              # Interactive setup wizard
npx esp-webflash-toolkit create NAME  # Scaffold a flash page
npx esp-webflash-toolkit url          # Generate hosted flash URL
npx esp-webflash-toolkit generate [config] [-o dir]  # Generate self-contained HTML
npx esp-webflash-toolkit init         # Initialize in current directory
```

---

## Worker API

Cloudflare Worker for config resolution and flash pages.

### Endpoints

GET /api/resolve/:user/:repo[/:tag]
  Resolve flash-config.json from a GitHub repo. Falls back to GitHub Releases API.
  Returns: v2 config JSON

GET /:user/:repo[/:tag]
  Flash page for a GitHub repo. Auto-resolves config and renders HTML.

GET /proxy/raw.githubusercontent.com/...
  CORS proxy for GitHub resources. Allowlist: raw.githubusercontent.com, api.github.com, github.com (release downloads only), objects.githubusercontent.com

POST /mcp
  MCP (Model Context Protocol) server endpoint. JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP.
  Tools: create_flasher, validate_config, resolve_repo, list_chips, list_field_presets

---

## MCP Server

The worker exposes an MCP endpoint at `/mcp` for AI tool integration.

### Connect

Claude Desktop / MCP client config:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "esp-webflash": {
      "url": "https://esp-webflash.workers.dev/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### Tools

**create_flasher** — Generate a hosted flash page URL
  Input: { name, repo?, firmware?, chip?, release?, fields?, variants?, branding?, postFlash? }
  Either firmware or variants (with firmware in each) is required. Top-level fields/chip propagate as defaults into variants.
  Returns: Flash page URL and config JSON

**validate_config** — Validate a flash-config.json
  Input: { config: <object> }
  Returns: { valid: boolean, errors: string[] }

**resolve_repo** — Resolve a GitHub repo to a flash config
  Input: { repo: "user/repo", tag?: string }
  Returns: Resolved v2 config JSON

**list_chips** — List supported ESP32 chip types
  Input: {}
  Returns: Array of { name, hexId, description }

**list_field_presets** — List available config field presets
  Input: {}
  Returns: Preset definitions (wifi, mqtt, device_name)

---

## Supported Chips

| Chip | Hex ID | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| esp32 | 0x0000 | Xtensa dual-core, original |
| esp32s2 | 0x0002 | Xtensa single-core, USB |
| esp32s3 | 0x0009 | Xtensa dual-core, AI/USB |
| esp32c3 | 0x0005 | RISC-V single-core |
| esp32c2 | 0x000C | RISC-V ultra-low-power |
| esp32c6 | 0x0012 | RISC-V with WiFi 6 |
| esp32h2 | 0x000D | RISC-V with Thread/Zigbee |
| esp8266 | — | Legacy, WiFi only |

## Browser Requirements

Web Serial API required: Chrome 89+, Edge 89+, Opera 75+.
Not supported: Firefox, Safari.

## Default Flash Offsets

| Partition | Offset | Size |
|-----------|--------|------|
| Firmware | 0x10000 (64KB) | varies |
| NVS | 0x9000 (36KB) | 0x6000 (24KB) |
